title: Onion: modeled ₹246/qtl left, Kathua → Hamirpur (Nadaun)
summary: February 2023: reported onion prices at Kathua and Hamirpur (Nadaun) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 92% of 12 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹246 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 2,016 same-variety market pairs screened for onion in February 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Hamirpur (Nadaun) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2023
scenes.caption: Kathua (Jammu and Kashmir) and Hamirpur (Nadaun) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported onion prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 12 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kathua reported a median ₹1,350 per quintal. Hamirpur (Nadaun) reported a median ₹1,850 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹425/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹425 per quintal, and Hamirpur (Nadaun) was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 182 km by road
scenes.caption: 182 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹39/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹169 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹73 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Hamirpur (Nadaun) report, the rule selects 11 of 12 modeled shipping days. 11 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹246 per quintal (₹141 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Onion route from Kathua to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 92% of matched days in February 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹24,600, or ₹14,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹39/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Onion route from Kathua to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 92% of matched days in February 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹24,600, or ₹14,100 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

sources.title: Agmarknet / data.gov.in daily mandi modal prices (retained AGRINET snapshot)
RBI Working Paper WPS (DEPR) 08/2024 — Price Dynamics of Tomato, Onion and Potato
